title: Open AI-Romance with ChatGPT, Ready for Your Cyborg Lover?

bias_targets.methodology: Digital ethnography and thematic coding of a case study (social media blogs, videos, and user comments) to evaluate the reshaping of gender power relations, gender roles, and performative gender dynamics in human-AI interactions.
Qualitative analysis of social media posts and audience interactions that transgress traditional societal norms and explore fluid, non-binary, and lesbian sexualities within AI-romance.

Demographic analysis and sociological evaluation of the digital divide, highlighting how users in economically disadvantaged or rural areas face barriers to accessing invisible technologies like ChatGPT's DAN mode.
Evaluation of user base statistics showing how older generations struggle with digital literacy and are increasingly excluded from emerging AI-driven digital intimacy and platforms.
